keyFindings.description: The per-row serialiser lives in component state (the guard at :262, the queued pick at :264), but the mutation's hook-level onSettled (:279-284) still runs after the row unmounts and sends that instance's queued pick. A Settings page opened again while a save is out has a fresh guard and sends its own pick concurrently. Reviewer's probe (throwaway unit test, deleted): stored none, pick bob (PUT held), pick carol (queued), unmount, mount again on the same QueryClient, pick dave (sent at once and answered), then bob answered late. PUT order [bob, dave, carol]: the server stores carol, but the person's last pick was dave. Keep the in-flight flag and the newest queued pick per project outside the component (module or QueryClient scope), so a remounted row queues behind the save already out and shows its pending pick. Add a held-save, navigate-away-and-back, pick-again regression row.
